thread:
marco: Quick architecture ask: i want to reframe the golden sample problem as three orthogonal axes so we can pick targeted mitigations: storage (where), identity/versioning (what), and runtime availability (how). sharing thoughts and looking for feedback.

anya: nice framing. storage: do we go CAS (content-addressed) + chunking or object-per-set? CAS reduces duplication but complicates partial pulls.

drew: CAS with manifest seems best: manifest lists sample ids (sha256) + tokenizer-variant. download clients fetch manifest then only missing chunks. helps CI runners cache shared chunks across models.

xia: versioning/identity is key. propose triple-id tuple: (canonical_id, semantic_tag, snapshot_ts). canonical_id immutable; semantic_tag like "top-200-v1"; snapshot_ts for human traceability. telemetry should emit canonical_id only. overrides emit both canonical_id and shadow_id.

marco: agree. also want promotion flow: shadow -> review -> promote creates new canonical_id that points to same underlying content but with new semantic_tag. older canonical_ids remain for historical joins.

tom: runtime availability: CI and offline smoke runs can't always hit the catalog. we need offline snapshots in repos for reproducibility. suggest small embedded manifests (not full payloads) that point at cached chunks in CI image or a signed-url cache.

gold-bot: stat: last month, 9% of CI failures were due to gold download timeouts. cache/local snapshot would significantly reduce flakiness.

anya: for storage lifecycle: store full raw payloads for 90 days, then dedupe+compress to long-term tier for 1-3 years. add retention policy per-privacy-level (PII redaction required).

drew: redaction: we need ingest pipeline step that scans and masks PII. if redaction changes expected outputs, we must store both redacted and original-hash under separate tokens and only make originals available to enterprise/private deployments. telemetry must never emit any PII.

xia: canonicalization rules: produce a normalized tokenization form per tokenizer-id and store that alongside raw input. when computing diffs, prefer normalized form. also compute a small semantic sketch (MinHash) for quick approximate similarity to detect duplicate gold sets across teams.

marco: how do we handle dedupe detection and user-visible diffs? we need a UI or CLI that shows a 5-line preview and a similarity score and highlights tokenization mismatches.

tom: cli: `ri gold inspect --id ID --preview 5 --check-similarity OTHER_ID` should fetch manifest + first N normalized inputs and compute sketch comparison locally. helps reviewers decide promotion.

ci-bot: note: runner images can bake top-200 chunk cache. we should provide a small signed-url proxy and a local TTL cache to reduce S3 load.

anya: api sketch: GET /v1/gold/{canonical_id} -> manifest (list of sample_sha, tokenizer_id, idx) + metadata (semantic_tag, retention, pii_level, canonical_created_ts) POST /v1/gold -> upload manifest + payloads (or multipart upload) -> returns canonical_id PUT /v1/gold/{canonical_id}/shadow -> registers a shadow id + metadata. all write endpoints require scoped ACL (write:gold, promote:gold).

drew: on promotion semantics: promotion should be a transaction: it copies manifest pointer to new canonical_id and queues a short audit job for reviewers. allow emergency rollback which reinstates previous canonical pointer. record all promotions in an append-only audit log (signed).

xia: monitoring: metric dims: download_latency_p50/p95, cache_hit_ratio, shadow_rate (ratio of runs using shadowed gold), promotion_lead_time, false_positive_alert_rate (pre/post migration). create SLOs for p95 download <2s for small manifests, p95 chunk-download <500ms from cache.

marco: concerns: storage cost and developer friction. mitigation: chunking + zstd; manifest-first workflow; and a small dev CLI that can snapshot a local override and request a shadow id with one command.

tom: cost control: implement per-repo quotas + org-level quotas and a slow-path for very large gold sets (needs approval). also enforce max-sample-size and max-total-bytes per-catalog-entry.

anya: security: signed urls + short TTLs for downloads; role-based promotor permissions; token-scoped read for CI. enterprise/private customers can opt out of dedupe/centralization and run a private catalog.

drew: migration plan: 1) read-only catalog + manifests only; 2) CLI support + cache in runner images; 3) migrate top N golds with CI opt-in; 4) enable shadowing and metrics; 5) promote stable sets and deprecate local copies. run 4-week experiment window for signal stability.

marco: action items: anya to draft concrete API + ACL list by Wed; drew to prototype CAS manifest layout + chunking tool by next Tue; tom to spec CI-cache baked image and signed-url proxy; xia to write promotion/audit flow and telemetry tagging rules; i'll draft the migration playbook.

gold-bot: adding ticket: infra/gold-catalog-arch-1789999999 for tracking.

marco: thanks all. final note: prefer content-addressing for dedupe but keep manifests human-friendly. we'll reconvene after initial prototypes.
